focal_blueprints.title_zh: 演讲中化繁为简讲解核心公式与算法直觉（Explaining Math Orally）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 PPT 上出现核心损失函数或注意力公式时，用 4 句通俗、精准的口语把公式背后的物理/几何直觉讲透，而不是在台上干巴巴念希腊字母。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 学术演讲方法详解页（Explaining Equations on Slides）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [先讲直觉目标 Intuition First]：Before looking at the math at the bottom of the slide, here is the simple physical intuition we want to capture.
S2 [日常/物理类比 Physical Analogy]：When two sensors monitor the same mechanical shaft, genuine vibrations share a consistent phase lag, whereas random electrical glitches fire out of phase.
S3 [指向公式核心项 Point to Key Term]：That is exactly what the red penalty term $\|\Delta \Phi\|_1$ inside the softmax does: it measures phase mismatch between channels.
S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Intuition Before Symbols -> Physical Reality -> Pointer to Highlighted Math Term -> Operational Effect. 绑定逻辑规则：L014, L018.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The formula on this slide is Q times K transpose divided by square root of d minus lambda times delta phi L1 norm, and then softmax times V.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 在台上把公式符号逐字念一遍（Q times K transpose divided by...）是学术演讲的大忌，听众听得云里雾里。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Before looking at the equation in the middle box, here is the physical intuition behind it. When two sensors sit on the same turbine shaft, genuine mechanical vibrations travel with a consistent phase lag, whereas random sensor glitches fire completely out of phase. That physical rule is captured by the highlighted red term, $\|\Delta \Phi_{Q,K}\|_1$, right inside the softmax. Whenever two channels show inconsistent phase lag, this penalty automatically zeroes out their attention weight.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Abstract 与 Introduction 立意与破题（BP01–BP08）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 凝练论文三点核心贡献（Contributions Summary）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 Introduction 最末尾清晰列出本文的三点核心贡献（理论/视角贡献 + 核心算法/架构贡献 + 实验与开源实证贡献）。
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [总起引导句 Lead-in]：In summary, our main contributions are threefold:
S2 [贡献 1：新视角/问题形式化 Conceptual/Formulation Contribution]：用强动词名物化或动词原形开头（We identify and formalize... / We establish...），点明打破了什么传统局限。
S3 [贡献 2：核心方法与模块 Algorithmic/Architectural Contribution]：We propose [Model/Mechanism], which integrates [A] and [B] to achieve [Theoretical/Functional Guarantee].
S4 [贡献 3：实证与系统突破 Empirical & Practical Contribution]：We demonstrate through extensive benchmarks and physical deployment that [Model] reduces [Metric] by [X%] while [Efficiency Gain].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Parallel Grammatical Structure（严格平行结构：全部用 We + 强及物动词 identify / propose / demonstrate 开头）。绑定逻辑规则：L002, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Our contributions are: 1. A new model is proposed. 2. Solving the non-stationary problem. 3. Good results on datasets.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 语法结构完全不平行（被动句 + 动名词短语 + 名词短语），且内容空泛。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold: (1) We formalize the amplitude-stationarity trade-off in long-horizon forecasting and prove that standard instance normalization bounds peak-load recoverability. (2) We propose DyTS-Net, a hybrid architecture that couples shift-invariant spectral attention with a continuous neural ODE scale tracker. (3) We demonstrate across eight public benchmarks and industrial wind-power telemetry that DyTS-Net lowers long-range MSE by up to 17.4% while cutting inference latency nearly in half.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 演讲总结页（Take-home Message）与问答（Q&A）从容应答段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想用于演讲最后一页总结（Take-home Messages）以及回答台下教授/审稿人犀利提问时的标准应答模板。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 学术演讲收尾页 & Q&A 现场问答
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [凝练核心带走信息 Core Take-Home Message]：To wrap up, if there is one takeaway from our work today, it is that [One-Sentence Core Principle].
S2 [成果三点速览 Rapid Recap]：By combining [A] and [B], [Model] delivers [Metric 1], [Metric 2], and [Open-Source/Practical Asset].
S3 [Q&A 礼貌接招与结论前置 Q&A Direct Answer]：(For Q&A) That is a great question regarding [Topic]—the short answer is [Direct Conclusion].
S4 [Q&A 展开与诚实边界 Q&A Elaboration]：In our current experiments, we observed [Empirical Fact], and extending this to [Questioner's Scenario] can be handled by [Concrete Mechanism].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Single Takeaway -> Quantitative Triad -> Q&A Direct Answer -> Empirical Grounding. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L019.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: That's all for my presentation. Thank you for listening. Do you have any questions? (When asked a hard question): Well, maybe we didn't test that, I think maybe it can work in the future.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 收尾平淡（That's all），回答问题时犹豫闪烁（Well, maybe... I think maybe...），显得对自己的工作极不自信。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: To wrap up, the key takeaway from our work is that non-stationary forecasting requires separating shift-invariant phase structure from continuous amplitude dynamics. Doing so lets DyTS-Net cut long-horizon error by up to 17% while running at half the computational cost, and our full code and weights are live at the QR code on screen. — [Q&A Response]: Thank you for that sharp question on irregular missing timestamps. The short answer is that our neural-ODE branch handles arbitrary time intervals natively: in our 30% random-dropout stress test, MSE degraded by less than 5%, and we can share the backup slide on irregular sampling right here.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 演绎推进（Zoom-In）与归纳提炼（Zoom-Out）双模切换
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 写方法论与议论文主论点段宜用演绎法（Zoom-In：首句抛出概括性规律，随后逐句拆解机理与实例）；写实验分析与看图小作文局部段宜用归纳法（Zoom-Out：先报告具体观测对比，末句提炼背后的理论规律）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Zoom-In: [General Claim] -> [Specific Mechanism] -> [Concrete Data]. | Zoom-Out: [Data Observation A vs. B] -> [Pattern Across Horizons] -> [Theoretical Takeaway].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 在实验分析段只罗列完数据就戛然而止，缺少最后一句 Zoom-Out 的机理升华（Why this pattern matters）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: At horizon 96, our MSE is 0.182. At horizon 336, our MSE is 0.245. At horizon 720, our MSE is 0.310, while Informer reaches 0.612.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: As the prediction horizon extends from 96 to 720 steps, our model's MSE rises modestly from 0.182 to 0.310, whereas Informer degrades sharply to 0.612. This widening performance gap demonstrates that decoupling trend projection from seasonal attention effectively suppresses long-range error compounding.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 第一句整合多步长数据趋势对比，第二句用 This widening performance gap demonstrates that... 完成归纳升华，点明“趋势与季节解耦抑制长程误差累积”的本质原因。

focal_logic_rules.category: Exam Essays (六级/雅思/托福论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 具象微观场景举例法：用一句话精确案例终结空洞模板（Micro-Case Grounding）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 六级/雅思/托福作文严禁编造虚假的调查数据（如 *A recent survey by Harvard shows 87.3% of people...*），也严禁写空洞口号（*For example, technology helps doctors a lot*）。最高分做法是用一句 `For instance, when [Specific Actor] implements [Specific Tool/Policy] in [Specific Scenario], [Concrete Measurable Effect]` 构建具象行业微观切片。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: For instance, when [municipal grid operators / radiology departments / logistics warehouses] deploy [specific technology/policy], they can [concrete operational improvement], thereby [link back to paragraph claim].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 举例要么假大空（For example, Jack studied hard and succeeded），要么编造一眼假的统计数字。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: For example, according to a recent survey, 92% of factories that use robots become very rich and successful.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: For instance, when automotive assembly plants deploy collaborative robots for repetitive welding and heavy chassis lifting, human technicians can transition toward quality inspection and fault diagnostics, reducing workplace musculoskeletal injuries while raising line throughput.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 不编造假百分比，而是通过“汽车总装厂部署协作机器人承担重复焊接与底盘搬运 -> 技工转向质检与故障诊断 -> 减少工伤并提升产线吞吐量”展现母语级具体说服力。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在 PPT 上出现核心损失函数或注意力公式时，用 4 句通俗、精准的口语把公式背后的物理/几何直觉讲透，而不是在台上干巴巴念希腊字母。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L013 演绎推进（Zoom-In）与归纳提炼（Zoom-Out）双模切换）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 在台上把公式符号逐字念一遍（Q times K transpose divided by...）是学术演讲的大忌，听众听得云里雾里。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

That physical rule is captured by the highlighted red term, $\|\Delta \Phi_{Q,K}\|_1$, right inside the softmax. Whenever two channels show inconsistent phase lag, this penalty automatically zeroes out their attention weight.

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Bridging non-stationary robustness and amplitude fidelity remains a core bottleneck in long-horizon forecasting. While instance normalization strips time-varying mean and variance shifts to stabilize attention weights, it simultaneously erases physical scale cues required to predict extreme load peaks. Conversely, retaining raw unnormalized inputs exposes self-attention layers to severe covariate shift, causing validation error to diverge over extended horizons. Resolving this tension requires a mechanism that disentangles intrinsic temporal dynamics from transient scale drift without discarding magnitude information.

Whereas PatchTST and iTransformer exhibit a 14-step phase lag and severe post-recovery overshoot, DyTS-Net tracks both the sharp downward ramp and subsequent stabilization within 5% amplitude error.
